description: This file defines a Go package 'opensearch' that implements a bulk request processor for OpenSearch, including methods for adding index and delete operations, flushing data, and managing periodic flushing with concurrency controls.

classes.name: Bulk
classes.description: A struct managing bulk operations for OpenSearch, including buffering, concurrency, and periodic flushing.

methods.name: NewBulk
methods.description: Constructor for creating a new Bulk processor with specified settings, client, timeout, and logger.

methods.name: IndexOp
methods.description: Adds an index operation with a document to the bulk request buffer.

methods.name: DeleteOp
methods.description: Adds a delete operation to the bulk request buffer.

methods.name: flushIfNecessary
methods.description: Checks if buffer or request count thresholds are exceeded and triggers flush if needed.

methods.name: Stop
methods.description: Stops the bulk processor, flushing remaining requests and stopping periodic flusher if active.

methods.name: periodicFlusher
methods.description: Runs in a goroutine to periodically flush the buffer based on configured interval.

methods.name: _flush
methods.description: Performs the actual flush of buffered requests to OpenSearch, called with lock held.

methods.name: Flush
methods.description: Public method to flush buffered requests.
